Tips.Text: On defense, press X or LB to take the player nearest the ball.
Hold RT or click the left stick to sprint -- stamina runs down while you do.
Press Start or P to pause. Settings are a button away.
When your side has the ball, switching player always takes you to the ball carrier.
Ratings on team select come straight from the roster: change a player, change the team.
A franchise season runs every week's games; the ones you don't play are simulated.
Hard hits wear players down. Rest them before an injury does it for you.
Practice is the place to learn the stick: nothing you do here counts.
